# browser-control-layer

> Browser control skill pack for AI agents: route web jobs, batch steps, hand clicks to a fresh runner, and close and check what it opens.

Install: `npx browser-control-layer`. Preview: `npx browser-control-layer install --dry-run`.

## Docs

- [Skill](https://github.com/aunysillyme/browser-control-layer/blob/HEAD/skills/browser-control-layer/SKILL.md): Read the invocation steps.
- [Method](https://github.com/aunysillyme/browser-control-layer/blob/HEAD/docs/METHOD.md): Browser practices and rationale.
- [Results](https://github.com/aunysillyme/browser-control-layer/blob/HEAD/docs/RESULTS.md): Package measurements and rerun commands.

## Reference

- [Commands](https://github.com/aunysillyme/browser-control-layer/blob/HEAD/README.md): Command entry points and companion credits.
- [Claude Code](https://github.com/aunysillyme/browser-control-layer/blob/HEAD/adapters/claude-code.md): Plugin and project installation.
- [Codex](https://github.com/aunysillyme/browser-control-layer/blob/HEAD/adapters/codex.md): Shared agent skill path.

## Optional

- [Remote browser](https://github.com/aunysillyme/browser-control-layer/blob/HEAD/skills/browser-control-layer/playbooks/remote-browser.md): Browser Run recipes.
- [Zero install](https://github.com/aunysillyme/browser-control-layer/blob/HEAD/adapters/zero-install.md): Paste the method into a chat.

## Part of a set

- [agent-personalizer](https://github.com/aunysillyme/agent-personalizer): AI custom instructions from approved entries: a profile and rules for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and ChatGPT, kept in sync from one source.
- [model-orchestrator](https://github.com/aunysillyme/model-orchestrator): Model router for AI coding agents: routes routine work to cheaper models with routing rules, 8 subagents, hooks and a CLI runner
- [website-build-skill](https://github.com/aunysillyme/website-build-skill): A skill pack that turns your AI into an expert website builder: current research, design, code, accessibility, speed, SEO and security, alone or as a team.
